summary: Master cost accounting and management in oil refineries with our expert-led training. Boost your career and improve operational efficiency today!
lede: Accounting for refineries tracks costs, allocates spending to process units, and links costs with refinery performance. It is designed for finance, operations, maintenance, and planning professionals who need to improve cost control and reporting. The course covers unit-cost modeling, budgeting and forecasting, variance analysis, and turnaround cost control to help explain cost movements and support decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with refinery operations, finance, maintenance, or planning data and need to improve cost control, allocation, and reporting. Refinery accountants responsible for unit and overhead cost capture. Cost engineers tracking process-unit economics and margin leakage. Production controllers linking throughput, downtime, and cost performance. Finance business partners preparing refinery budgets and variance packs. Planning analysts supporting crude slate and production cost decisions. Maintenance cost controllers managing turnaround and work-order spend. Operations managers reviewing efficiency, utilities, and cost exceptions. Management accountants consolidating refinery performance into leadership reports. Energy analysts monitoring fuel, steam, and power cost drivers. Project controllers evaluating refinery capex and cost justification.
prerequisites: A laptop with Microsoft Excel is required for the workshop exercises. Access to Power BI is helpful for dashboard activities, but not mandatory. Participants should be prepared to work with sample refinery cost data, budget templates, and basic operational reports during the course.
